children.name: Ctenolophon chorkholaensis Prasad & Pandey, 2008
children.description: Ctenolophon chorkholaensis Prasad & Pandey, 2008 — a magnoliopsida species in the genus Ctenolophon.

children.name: Ctenolophon englerianus Mildbr.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Nigeria to N. Angola. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ctenolophon parvifolius Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is Pen. Thailand to Malesia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
